summary: One-frame record attached by esv::inventory::InteractionRequestSystem (game per-frame update bg3.exe+0x3473C80, Toolkit ProcessMemberRequests) to an item that changes hands, consumed by esv::StoryCharacterEventManager::OnInventoryInteraction -> ThrowCharacterStoleItem, which raises the Osiris event CharacterStoleItem((CHARACTER)_Character, (ITEM)_Item, (GUIDSTRING)_ItemRootTemplate, (REAL)_X, (REAL)_Y, (REAL)_Z, (CHARACTER)_OldOwner, (ITEM)_SrcContainer, (INTEGER)_Amount, (INTEGER)_GoldValue). Registered by bg3.exe+0x3476550 with size 0x68; destructor bg3.exe+0x22D03D0 releases the FixedString at +0x58 and the STDStrings at +0x40 and +0x18.

fields.name: OldOwner
fields.evidence: Adder bg3.exe+0x3476550 sets 0xFFC0000000000000 (null handle). Writer bg3.exe+0x3473C80 (line ~632) stores an entity looked up per item. Toolkit OnInventoryInteraction (EoCServer.dll+0xEF56D0) turns *component into the Character passed as _OldOwner of the Osiris event CharacterStoleItem (ThrowCharacterStoleItem param 3).

fields.name: Position
fields.evidence: Writer bg3.exe+0x3473C80 copies 8 + 4 bytes from +0x10/+0x18 of a component of the item (FUN_140e5a590: a translation); OnInventoryInteraction takes +8 (8 bytes) and +0x10 (4 bytes) as the default _X/_Y/_Z of CharacterStoleItem (replaced by the container's bound centre when there is one). Adder zeroes +8 and the dword +0x10.

fields.name: _Pad14
fields.evidence: Never written by the adder or the writer; alignment for the 8-aligned STDString at +0x18.

fields.name: ItemName
fields.evidence: Writer: ls::STDString::STDString(+0x18, template name at GameObjectTemplate+0x20). ThrowCharacterStoleItem (EoCServer.dll+0xEFD300) builds the _Item GUIDSTRING from STDString +0x18 and Guid +0x30. Destructor/adder show ls::STDString (size +0x28, capacity +0x2C = 0xF).

fields.name: ItemUuid
fields.evidence: Writer copies 4 dwords from the item's uuid component (FUN_14107e6f0) to +0x30..+0x3F; ThrowCharacterStoleItem passes (Guid*)(+0x30) as the _Item parameter.

fields.name: RootTemplateName
fields.evidence: Writer: STDString(+0x40, name of the ROOT template - the template is resolved through GlobalTemplateManager::GetTemplateRaw when it is an override); ThrowCharacterStoleItem builds the _ItemRootTemplate GUIDSTRING from +0x40 and FixedString +0x58. Capacity at +0x54 = 0xF in the adder.

fields.name: RootTemplateId
fields.evidence: Writer: FixedString assign (FUN_14412e090) from root template +0x10 (its id); adder sets 0xFFFFFFFF; ThrowCharacterStoleItem uses it as the GUID part of _ItemRootTemplate.

fields.name: Amount
fields.evidence: Osiris CharacterStoleItem _Amount (ThrowCharacterStoleItem SetParamValue(+0x5C, INTEGER, 8)); writer stores the per-item amount of the request; adder default 1.

fields.name: GoldValue
fields.evidence: Osiris CharacterStoleItem _GoldValue (SetParamValue(+0x60, INTEGER, 9)); writer stores the result of FUN_144211d80(world, item, amount, ...) - the value of the stolen amount; adder default 0.

fields.name: _Pad64
fields.evidence: Never written; tail padding to the 8-byte alignment of the 0x68-byte record.

second_pass: Every member is settled by the Windows writer bg3.exe+0x3473C80 and adder bg3.exe+0x3476550 plus the Toolkit consumer ThrowCharacterStoleItem, which maps each member to a parameter of the Osiris event CharacterStoleItem (_OldOwner, _X/_Y/_Z, _Item, _ItemRootTemplate, _Amount, _GoldValue).
